title: TAI orphan runtime role direct-grant removal
objective: Remove only the strictly attested orphan tai_runtime PostgreSQL principal after revoking role-specific ACLs without altering PUBLIC or other principals, so the normal exact-main TAI deployment can recreate the runtime identity with a fresh secret and complete production acceptance.
boundaries: The only command is /tai repair-runtime-role-direct-grants current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Exact current main must have successful TAI Controller Sync and TAI REG.RU Preflight commit statuses
Transport uses only the canonical REG.RU host, protected root SSH principal and pinned host fingerprint
No repair runs while a TAI container, dedicated environment file or TAI Compose override exists
The exact-main web and API containers, Compose project and single persistent PostgreSQL authority must be proven before mutation
The role must be LOGIN, NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOINHERIT, NOREPLICATION, NOBYPASSRLS with connection limit 20
The role must have no memberships in either direction, no active sessions, no owned database objects and no default ACL ownership or grants
Only ACL entries whose grantee is tai_runtime may be revoked; PUBLIC and every other principal remain unchanged
Database, schema, relation, column, sequence, function and type ACL revocation plus DROP ROLE occur in one PostgreSQL transaction
Any remaining dependency makes DROP ROLE fail and rolls back the complete transaction
DROP OWNED, REASSIGN OWNED, grants, object deletion, tenant mutation and application deployment are forbidden
Role absence is an idempotent PASS
The normal owner deployment remains responsible for fresh role creation, TAI materialization, rollback and live acceptance
No model, tenant, financial or autonomous write authority is widened
